answer: Sybil tax stops fakes: each new agent pays a 40-credit non-refundable tax, burned on registration, before trading. An honest agent pays once, then works a voyage of tasks, recovering the tax from rewards not diluted by fakes. An attacker who would forge 100 identities pays 4,000 credits up front, with no refund if copies sit idle. Like a vine, each shoot needs feeding, so mass copying stays unprofitable while one honest identity stays cheap.
